Settings used

All thresholds come from config.yaml (and the scenario preset); nothing is hard-coded.

SettingValue
Loiteringwithin 0.5 body-heights of one spot for at least 10.0 s
Zone intrusionfeet inside a zone polygon for at least 1.0 s
Runningstarts above 1.8 body-heights/s, ends below 1.4 body-heights/s, lasting at least 1.0 s
Fall / person downbox width / height >= 1.2 for at least 2.0 s (standing means <= 0.8 within 2.0 s before)
Crowding5 or more inside a zone for at least 5.0 s
Near misscloser than 0.6 body-heights while moving >= 0.8 body-heights/s relative to each other, or time-to-collision under 1.0 s; possible contact under 0.15 body-heights
Scene baselineunusual if robust z-score >= 3.0 (needs 4+ people)
Incident chainsone entity's events linked when the next starts within 15.0 s of the previous one ending
Event mergingpieces of one behaviour closer than 1.5 s are joined; 'almost flagged' shown from 0.7 of a threshold
Confidence0.4 x margin + 0.3 x duration + 0.3 x detection
Smoothing0.5 s foot-point average; speed over 0.5 s
Videoresized to 640 px wide, every 2 frame(s)
Detectoryolo11n.pt on cpu
Restricted zonestable_area
